title: DAG Circuit Satisfiability and Its CNF Encoding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean DAG circuit on $n$ input variables, and suppose that $C$ is fan-in-two. Then the pair consisting of $n$ and $C$ belongs to the set of fan-in-two satisfiable DAG circuits if and only if the CNF formula associated to $C$ has width at most three and is satisfiable.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean DAG circuit on some natural number $n$ of input variables
